description: Round-five held-out synthetic meetings for the variant robustness eval, written blind to earlier rounds and to the Rust implementation. Settings are a soil research lab, a wedding venue, a rowing club committee, a choir, an orchard co-op and a museum loan. They cover conditional and negated commitments, negated decisions, spoken headings, vendor and product names that look like people, restricted prices, adjacent counts, budgets, suggestions that are not tasks, date corrections in several phrasings, completed statuses and reported speech.

segments.speaker: Saskia
segments.text: We agreed to send the soil samples to Ferris, the sequencing vendor, on the 14th if the extraction yields pass QC, and Tobin will label the sample tubes.

segments.speaker: Tobin
segments.text: I'll label the tubes by Wednesday. Actually, make that Thursday, I'm out in the field on Wednesday.

segments.speaker: Mireille
segments.text: Ferris quoted 96 samples per plate, at 40 euros a sample, or 32 euros a sample for academic accounts.

segments.speaker: Saskia
segments.text: Let me just ask, could someone look into a second freezer? That's a question for later, not a task for today.

segments.speaker: Mireille
segments.text: I'll book the confocal microscope for November 3rd as long as my safety induction is signed off.

segments.speaker: Tobin
segments.text: The ethics amendment is already approved. Petra from facilities told me the backup freezer was repaired yesterday.

segments.speaker: Saskia
segments.text: We decided not to renew the Ferris contract next year. And I won't order more extraction kits until the QC results are back.

segments.speaker: Odile
segments.text: Room layout. We agreed to set up 14 round tables and 112 chairs in the orangery on June 19, provided that the guest list stays under 120.

segments.speaker: Bram
segments.text: Catering: Bellamy, our caterer, quoted 58 pounds a head for the dinner, or 34 pounds a head for children under twelve.

segments.speaker: Celeste
segments.text: I'll send Bellamy the final menu by the 5th of June, sorry, I mean the 6th of June, unless Bram changes the dessert again.

segments.speaker: Odile
segments.text: Catering: the tasting session is already finished, so that's done.

segments.speaker: Bram
segments.text: Room layout again. I won't confirm the band until Odile checks the noise limit, and we decided not to use the garden for the ceremony.

segments.speaker: Celeste
segments.text: I should mention, Odile told me the council refused the fireworks permit.

segments.speaker: Philippa
segments.text: Treasurer's report. We have 6 boats insured and 38 rowers registered this season. The regatta budget is 2,400 pounds, and we're planning 3 away fixtures.

segments.speaker: Garrick
segments.text: Equipment: I'll repair the double scull by the 21st as long as the boatyard sends the parts.

segments.speaker: Anouk
segments.text: Not the 21st, the 28th. The boatyard is shut that week.

segments.speaker: Garrick
segments.text: Fair enough, the 28th then.

segments.speaker: Desmond
segments.text: I'd suggest we look at a new trailer, but that's only a suggestion, nobody needs to take it on yet.

segments.speaker: Anouk
segments.text: I'll renew the club's water safety certificate by Friday.

segments.speaker: Philippa
segments.text: Equipment: the new oars have already been delivered and paid for.

segments.speaker: Garrick
segments.text: Any other business. We decided not to raise the membership fees this year, and I'm not going to book the coach for the regatta until Philippa signs off the budget.

segments.speaker: Desmond
segments.text: Fenella at the sponsor said the sponsorship money has been paid in full.

segments.speaker: Margit
segments.text: Concert planning. We have 18 sopranos and 11 tenors confirmed for the spring concert on April 25th.

segments.speaker: Leopold
segments.text: Tickets are 15 pounds, or 10 pounds for students with a valid card.

segments.speaker: Ysolde
segments.text: Our ticketing system, Tilly, shows 140 seats sold so far.

segments.speaker: Margit
segments.text: We agreed to hire the harpist only if the church lets us rehearse in the nave, and Leopold will print the programmes by April 18.

segments.speaker: Ysolde
segments.text: Sorry to correct you, but it has to be April 16 instead, the printer closes for Easter.

segments.speaker: Leopold
segments.text: Fine, April 16. I won't order the extra music stands unless the arts council approves our grant.

segments.speaker: Margit
segments.text: Concert planning, last item. The venue deposit is paid, and Reverend Oyelaran said we can use the vestry for warm-ups. We decided not to record the concert this year.

segments.speaker: Brigid
segments.text: Harvest: we've picked 340 crates of apples and 85 sacks of potatoes so far.

segments.speaker: Hollis
segments.text: Market stall. The co-op budget for the autumn market is 1,500 pounds, and we plan to run the stall on 6 Saturdays.

segments.speaker: Eamon
segments.text: I'll deliver the cider apples to Wexcombe Press on the 2nd of October, provided that the lorry passes its MOT.

segments.speaker: Tamsin
segments.text: Eamon, sorry, it should be the 9th of October, not the 2nd. The press is closed that week.

segments.speaker: Eamon
segments.text: Right, the 9th of October it is.

segments.speaker: Hollis
segments.text: Harvest: the Bertram grain dryer was installed last week. Brigid will train the volunteers on it once the insurer signs off.

segments.speaker: Tamsin
segments.text: Just a thought, not an action: maybe we could sell jam at the stall. Separately, I'll set up the card reader by Friday.

segments.speaker: Brigid
segments.text: Market stall: we decided not to take a second pitch, and I won't sign the pitch agreement until Hollis has read it.

segments.speaker: Aurelie
segments.text: We agreed to ship the Vasquez tapestry to the Corran Gallery on March 3rd once the condition report is signed, and Konstantin will arrange the insurance.

segments.speaker: Konstantin
segments.text: I'll arrange the insurance by February 20th, or rather February 24th, the broker is away that week.

segments.speaker: Nkem
segments.text: Transport: we need 2 crates and 3 art handlers for the move, and the transport budget is 6,800 euros.

segments.speaker: Konstantin
segments.text: Ottilie Brandt, the gallery director, told me their climate survey is complete.

segments.speaker: Nkem
segments.text: I won't release the courier booking until the insurance certificate arrives. And we decided not to lend the matching cushion covers.

segments.speaker: Aurelie
segments.text: Can I ask, should we film the unpacking? That's not a task, just a question. Meanwhile, I'll email the loan agreement to Ottilie on Monday.

segments.speaker: Nkem
segments.text: Transport: the courier has already confirmed the route.
